div.head: Wi 24
div.ab: Gif folcesmannes esne tihte ciricanmannes esne, oþþe ciricanmannes esne tihte folcesmannes esne, his dryhten hine ane his aþe geclensige.
Gif folcesmannes esne tihte ciricanmannes esne, oþþe ciricanmannes esne tihte folcesmannes esne, his dryhten hine ane his aþe geclensige.
Gif folcesmannes esne tihte ciricanmannes esne, oþþe ciricanmannes esne tihte folcsmannes esne, his dryhten hine ane his aþe geclensige.

Wenn ein Knecht eines Laien den Knecht eines Kirchenmannes anklagt, oder ein Kecht eines Kirchenmannes den Knecht eines Laien anklagt, so reinige ihn [den Verklagten] dessen Herr durch seinen alleinigen Eid.
If a layman’s servant accuses the servant of a churchman, or a churchman’s servant accuses a layman’s servant, let his lord clear him [the accused] by his sole oath.
If a layman’s servant accuse the servant of an ecclesiastic, or if an ecclesiastic’s servant accuse the servant of a layman, his lord shall clear him by his own oath.
If the servant of a layman accuses the servant of an ecclesiastic or the servant of an ecclesiastic accuses the servant of a layman, his lord is to clear him with his oath alone.
If a layman’s servant brings a charge against a churchman’s servant, or a churchman’s servant brings a charge against a layman’s servant, his lord should clear him by his oath alone.

note.seg: Vgl. Gl Unfreie 21g. — folces man nimmt Toller als zwei Wörter. Doch mindestens der Begriff ist einheitlich. Die Bedeutung ‘Laie’ (s. Wb folc 6, folcisc, folclage und bei Toller folcstow) ist hier durch den Ggs. cirican man gesichert

Cf. Gl Unfreie 21g. — Toller takes folces man as two words. But at least the concept is a single one. The meaning ‘layman’ (see Wb folc 6, folcisc, folclage and in Toller folcstow) is assured here by the contrast with cirican man

Eines Geistlichen persönlich, mit Ausnahme des in 22f. behandelten Bischofs und des Stiftskonvents. — Nicht berücksichtigt zu werden brauchte der Fall, dass Eines Herrn Unfreie einander verklagten: da trat herrschaftliche Gerichtsbarkeit (s. d. Gl 14) ein. — Im Gl Eineid als 2b nachzutragen

Of a cleric personally, with the exception of the bishop and the collegiate convent dealt with in 22f. — The case of unfree men of one and the same lord accusing one another did not need to be considered: there the lord’s jurisdiction (see that word in Gl 14) came into play. — To be added in Gl Eineid as 2b
